description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for the CodeMirror editor, specifically for Handlebars templates. It includes multiple mode definitions handling different parts of Handlebars syntax and integrates multiplexing mode for embedding Handlebars within other modes.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a simple mode for syntax highlighting Handlebars tags.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMode
methods.description: Defines a complex mode for syntax highlighting Handlebars templates with multiplexing support.

methods.name: CodeMirror.getMode
methods.description: Retrieves a specified mode configuration, used for nested mode definitions.

methods.name: CodeMirror.multiplexingMode
methods.description: Creates a multiplexing mode that embeds one mode within another, used here to embed Handlebars syntax inside other modes.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMIME
methods.description: Associates a MIME type with the Handlebars mode for content-type detection.
